method: Public APIs of the reference npm package executed in Node; inputs and outputs recorded, replayed by tests/packages-math/paths.tsx. Equality is exact except getBoundingBox, scalePath, resetPath and centerPath, which compare numbers within a relative 1e-9 because the reference evaluates cubic bounding-box extrema differently in the last bits. warp:* and ease:* strings stand for functions defined identically in generator and test. An {error} reference must also throw. No implementation source copied.
